# Containerlab, netlab, and Linux Cheat Sheet

Run commands in the lab directory. Use the privilege level and filenames required by your installation.

## Containerlab

```sh
sudo containerlab deploy -t topology.clab.yml
sudo containerlab inspect -t topology.clab.yml
docker ps
docker exec -it clab-LAB-NODE sh
sudo containerlab destroy -t topology.clab.yml
```

Destroying the topology stops and removes its nodes. `--cleanup` also removes the lab directory and saved state; copy evidence and configurations first.

## netlab

```sh
netlab up
netlab status
netlab connect NODE
netlab down
```

Run these against the netlab topology and provider configured for the lab; available options depend on the installed version. Preserve generated artifacts or saved configurations before teardown.

## Linux network evidence

```sh
ip -br link
ip -br address
ip route show
ip -6 route show
ip route get 192.0.2.1
ip neigh show
ss -tulpn
sudo tcpdump -ni eth1
```

Inside a node, use its interface names. Capture on both ends of a link where practical and compare the results with the routing table and addressing diagram.
